abstract: Six embryonal carcinoma (EC) cell lines that are resistant to the cytotoxic, galactose-specific lectin abrin were isolated from mutagenized populations of either PSA-1 or F9 cells. The LD10 for each of the variant lines was at least 150-fold greater than that for parental cells. Indirect cytotoxicity tests demonstrated that all of the variant cell lines lacked both Stage Specific Embryonic Antigen-1 (SSEA-1, less than 1% of wild-type levels) and Forsmann antigen (less than 5% of wild-type levels). When abrin-resistant cells were fused to previously isolated SSEA-1-negative cells (M. J. Rosenstraus (1983), Dev. Biol. 99, 318-323) that express Forsmann antigen, the resulting hybrids expressed SSEA-1. This implies the mutation conferring abrin resistance is in a different gene than that defined by the previously isolated mutation. Thus, we have identified two genes that are required for SSEA-1 expression, one of which also appears to be required for Forsmann antigen expression. The F9-derived variants differentiated into visceral-like or parietal-like endoderm when treated with retinoic acid in the absence or presence of 8-bromo-cAMP, respectively. PSA-1-derived variants formed differentiated teratocarcinomas containing derivatives of all three germ layers. Thus the SSEA-1 and Forsmann haptenic determinants are not required for EC cells to differentiate into a broad spectrum of cell types; nor do they appear to be involved in the cell-cell interactions that are postulated to regulate visceral versus parietal endoderm differentiation.
abstract_ja: アブリン耐性を示す胎児性癌(EC)細胞株6株を、変異誘発したPSA-1またはF9細胞集団から分離しました。各変異株のLD10は親細胞の少なくとも150倍でした。間接細胞傷害試験により、全変異株はSSEA-1（野生型の1%未満）およびForsmann抗原（野生型の5%未満）の両方を欠くことが示されました。アブリン耐性細胞を、Forsmann抗原を発現する既報のSSEA-1陰性細胞（Rosenstraus, 1983）と融合させると、得られたハイブリッドはSSEA-1を発現しました。これは、アブリン耐性を与える変異が既報の変異とは別の遺伝子にあることを意味します。よって、SSEA-1発現に必要な遺伝子を2つ同定し、そのうち1つはForsmann抗原の発現にも必要と思われます。F9由来変異株はレチノイン酸処理により、8-ブロモcAMPの存在下または非存在下で、それぞれ内臓型または壁側型内胚葉へ分化しました。PSA-1由来変異株は、三胚葉すべての誘導体を含む分化した奇形癌を形成しました。したがって、SSEA-1およびForsmann抗原の決定基は、EC細胞が広範囲の細胞型へ分化するためには必要ではなく、内臓型と壁側型内胚葉分化を調節するとされる細胞間相互作用にも関与しないと考えられます。
